lines.en: label nikispring5:
A short while later...
lines.zh: 片刻之后……

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime1
: Hah...I’m starting to get the feeling Noriko won’t be joining us after all.
lines.zh: : 哈……我开始有种感觉，Noriko 大概终究是不会来了。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’ll come eventually, Aunt Niki. We probably just need to wait a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 她总会来的，Niki 阿姨。我们大概只要再多等一会儿。

lines.en: : I don’t think so, Ami. Haven’t we been in here for, like...an hour?
lines.zh: : 我不这么觉得，Ami。我们泡进来是不是已经……差不多一个小时了？

lines.en: : Has it really been that long? I feel like we only just stepped in.
lines.zh: : 真有那么久吗？我感觉我们才刚进来。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime2
: You’re sure you’re not overheating? Because we don’t need to stay in here if you are. Are you thirsty, maybe? Should I call out to Patrice for a bottle of-
lines.zh: : 你确定没有泡晕吗？要是晕了，我们不用非待在这儿。要不要喝点什么？我喊 Patrice 拿一瓶——

lines.en: : I’m fine, really. But thanks for asking. And sorry I’m not exciting enough to entertain you without Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我真的没事。不过谢谢关心。也抱歉我不够有趣，少了 Noriko 就没法逗你开心。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime3
: What? No. That’s not it at all. I just thought you’d be more comfortable with her around since-
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。完全不是那么回事。我只是觉得有她在你会更自在，因为——

lines.en: : Since you’ve already made a trillion attempts to get closer to me and I’ve squandered them all by bringing up the amount of sex I want to have with my dad?
lines.zh: : 因为你已经试了无数次想跟我拉近距离，而我每次都把话题拐到「我想和爸爸做多少次爱」上，白白浪费了？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime4
: I was going to say since she’s your age and you know her better. But yeah, that too I guess.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说的是，她跟你同龄，你更熟她。不过，嗯，那个也算吧。

lines.en: : Can we not talk about dad sex anymore, though? I kind of just want this to be normal and relaxing since I’ll be working most of tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 不过我们能别再聊「爸爸性爱」了吗？我明天大部分时间都要工作，现在只想这样正常又放松地待着。

lines.en: : I can be normal, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我可以很正常。

lines.en: : You’re wrong about one thing, though. I don’t know Noriko as well as I know you.
lines.zh: : 不过有一件事你说错了。我对 Noriko 的了解，不如对你。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime5
: Really? Even though you guys are in the same class? You don’t, like...hang out during lunch or anything? Pass notes during math?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你们不是同班吗？你们不……午饭时一起玩什么的？数学课上递纸条？

lines.en: : Nobody “passes notes” anymore, Aunt Niki. We all have cell phones now. You’re dating yourself again.
lines.zh: : 现在没人「递纸条」了，Niki 阿姨。大家都有手机。你又暴露年龄了。

lines.en: : So, if I go through your cell phone, I’m not going to see any messages from Noriko sent during school hours?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果我翻你的手机，也不会看到 Noriko 在上课时间发来的消息？

lines.en: : Nope. In fact, you probably won’t see many messages at all.
lines.zh: : 不会。事实上，你可能根本看不到几条消息。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime6
: Most of my friends stopped going out of their way to contact me after that whole breakdown thing happened. It’s pretty much just Ayane and sometimes Molly in my messages now.
lines.zh: : 那次崩溃的事之后，我的大多数朋友都不再特意联系我了。现在我的消息里基本只剩 Ayane，偶尔有 Molly。

lines.en: : Not even that Maya girl?
lines.zh: : 连那个 Maya 都没有？

lines.en: : We don’t really text. Our relationship is a little...different from how I am with my other friends.
lines.zh: : 我们不太发短信。我们的关系跟我和其他朋友之间有点……不一样。

lines.en: : Would...you like me to text you more?
lines.zh: : 你……希望我多给你发短信吗？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime7
: You don’t have to feel bad for me, okay? I’m fine with things being this way. It gives me more time to focus on what’s actually important.
lines.zh: : 你不用同情我，好吗？这样子我觉得挺好的。这样我才有更多时间专注在真正重要的事上。

lines.en: : Don’t bring up dad sex. I told you no dad sex.
lines.zh: : 别提爸爸性爱。我说了不许提。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime8
: I won’t. I meant myself.
lines.zh: : 不提。我说的是我自己。

lines.en: : You...did?
lines.zh: : 你……指的是？

lines.en: : Mhm. I can’t be the perfect Ami if I’m always distracted by what everyone else is doing. And I have been. Distracted, I mean. Which is why it’s been a while since I’ve felt 100%%.
lines.zh: : 嗯。如果我老是分心去在意别人在做什么，就没法当完美的 Ami 了。而我确实一直如此。我是说，一直分心。所以我好久都没有 100%% 的状态了。

lines.en: : What do you mean by “perfect Ami?” People can’t be perfect. And I don’t want you trying to live up to unrealistic standards like that. It’s not healthy.
lines.zh: : 「完美的 Ami」是什么意思？人是不可能完美的。我也不想让你去够那种不切实际的标准。这不健康。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime9
: Do you really believe people can’t be perfect? You mean you’re not trying to do that too?
lines.zh: : 你真的相信人不可能完美吗？你是说，你自己也没在试着做到完美？

lines.en: : What, be perfect? Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 什么，追求完美？绝对没有。

lines.en: : But you’re an idol. Isn’t that your job?
lines.zh: : 可你是偶像啊。这不就是你的工作吗？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime10
: I’m a Japanese idol, Ami. It’s those fucking K-Pop girls who turn themselves into statues for the sake of their work. We actually put emphasis on flaws over here.
lines.zh: : 我是日本偶像，Ami。把自己雕成雕像的是那些该死的韩流女团。我们这边反而强调缺点。

lines.en: : Do you...have a vendetta against K-Pop, Aunt Niki?
lines.zh: : 你……跟韩流有仇吗，Niki 阿姨？

lines.en: : Mmm...it’s less of a vendetta and more just feeling bad for them. All those plastic surgeries...veneers...ridiculous diets. It’s like they can’t even live or be themselves.
lines.zh: : 嗯……与其说有仇，不如说是同情她们。那些整容……贴片……荒唐的节食。她们简直连活成自己都做不到。

lines.en: : If that’s the case, what are your flaws then? Because I can’t find any at all.
lines.zh: : 既然如此，那你的缺点是什么？因为我一个都找不到。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime11
: Then you’re either lying to me or not looking hard enough, because I have tons. Just most of them don’t really affect my public persona, thankfully.
lines.zh: : 那你不是在骗我，就是看得不够仔细，因为我有一大堆。所幸大部分都不太影响我的公众形象。

lines.en: : It’s probably hard to emphasize any of that to the public then, right?
lines.zh: : 那大概很难把这些展现给公众吧？

lines.en: : Cause like, if Japanese idols are supposed to be imperfect, and all of your flaws occur behind the scenes, what exactly are you trying to portray when you’re on stage?
lines.zh: : 就是说，如果日本偶像本该是不完美的，而你的缺点又都发生在幕后，那你在台上到底想展现什么？

lines.en: : See, that’s the interesting part. Because while my physical image might be perfect, the flaws come out in droves when you actually listen to what I’m singing about.
lines.zh: : 瞧，这就是有趣的地方。因为虽然我的外在形象可能是完美的，可你一旦真的去听我唱的是什么，那些缺点就会成群结队地冒出来。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime12
: At least in all of the songs that don’t get really popular. But those songs are how I connect with my audience on a real level. That’s where Niki is.
lines.zh: : 至少在所有不太红的歌里是这样。但那些歌才是我真正跟听众建立联结的方式。那才是 Niki 所在的地方。

lines.en: : I’m still not really sure I get it, but I don’t really pay much attention to lyrics so...
lines.zh: : 我还是不太确定我听懂了，不过我平时也不大注意歌词……

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime13
: Aren’t you a poet now? You mean to tell me you can write stuff like that and not listen to the words of a song?
lines.zh: : 你现在不是诗人了吗？你是说，你能写出那种东西，却不去听歌里的词？

lines.en: : I’m not a very good one. I sort of just...write how I feel and...rhyme stuff.
lines.zh: : 我不算什么好诗人。我大概就是……把感受写下来，然后……押个韵。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’re great. You just come from a family of poets, so it’s probably hard to compare yourself to them and not feel a little disadvantaged.
lines.zh: : 我相信你很棒。你出身诗人世家，拿自己跟他们比，难免会觉得有点吃亏。

lines.en: : My music’s just like that too, though. I write how I feel and try to rhyme stuff.
lines.zh: : 我的音乐也是这样。我把感受写下来，试着押个韵。

lines.en: : My producers hate me for it, of course. And yes, they do help with the production, but writing my own lyrics is something I refuse to budge on because I kind of...want to emphasize my flaws.
lines.zh: : 我的制作人当然恨死我这点了。没错，制作上他们确实有帮忙，但自己写词这件事我死也不肯让步，因为我有点……想突出自己的缺点。

lines.en: : It makes me feel better about myself. It’s how I kept going when your father left me behind.
lines.zh: : 这让我对自己感觉好一些。当年你父亲抛下我的时候，我就是靠这个撑过来的。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime14
: I just have to be creative when I do it. Generic-ish, I guess. Use symbolism instead of things that actually happened because the hard truth would just turn people off.
lines.zh: : 只是我得玩点花样。大概要写得通用一些。用象征，而不是照搬真事，因为太赤裸的真相只会把人吓跑。

lines.en: : “Hard truth” as in the fact that you’ve been obsessed with my dad for over a decade now and can’t leave him alone despite how much you know you should?
lines.zh: : 「赤裸的真相」——就是说，你已经迷恋了我爸十多年，明知道该放手却怎么也放不下？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime15
: Bingo. Anyone who pays any amount of attention to my lyrics understands that there’s something I can’t let go of.
lines.zh: : 答对了。任何稍微留意我歌词的人，都能明白有件事我放不下。

lines.en: : They get that I’m clingy and obsessive and desperate and scared. And they get it because I share it with them. Those are the flaws I emphasize. Internal ones.
lines.zh: : 他们明白我很黏人、很偏执、很绝望、很害怕。他们能明白，是因为我把这些分享给了他们。这就是我突出的缺点。内里的那些。

lines.en: : Which creates this sweet duality because you’ve got this picture-perfect babe who everyone’s pining over that is actually just permanently dying on the inside due to the way she naturally is!
lines.zh: : 这就形成了一种甜美的双面性——外面是个完美如画、人人倾慕的尤物，内里却因为自己的本性而永远在慢慢死去！

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. I get it now. I can see the flaws when you put it that way. I just try not to think of stuff like that as a flaw to begin with.
lines.zh: : 好吧，嗯，我现在懂了。你这么说我就能看出那些缺点了。只是我本来就不太愿意把这种事当成缺点。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime16
: Because you’re crazy too. And you do the same thing as me. Just you happen to be related to the thing you’re obsessed with.
lines.zh: : 因为你也疯啊。你跟我做的是一样的事。只不过你迷恋的对象碰巧跟你有血缘关系。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime17
: Well, I like to consider that a strength. It just means that my love transcends societal norms while everyone else’s is weak and breakable.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我倒觉得那是优点。这只说明我的爱超越了社会规范，而别人的爱又软弱又易碎。

lines.en: : Heh. I kind of wish my love was breakable. It would definitely make my life easier.
lines.zh: : 呵。我倒有点希望我的爱能碎掉。那肯定会让我的日子好过很多。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime18
: But also — I wouldn’t be able to do things like this if it was. And you’d probably be in this bath with that Sara lady right now if that were the case.
lines.zh: : 不过——如果它真能碎，我也就没法做现在这些事了。而且真那样的话，现在跟你泡澡的大概就是那个 Sara 女士了。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re really jealous of her, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你真的很嫉妒她啊。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime19
: You could have so easily kept me oblivious to her existence and you decided not to. This is your fault, twerp.
lines.zh: : 你本来可以轻轻松松让我对她的存在一无所知，你却偏不。这都是你的错，小鬼。

lines.en: : It’s just a little funny. Cute, even. Because you never seem to get jealous when me or my friends spend time with my dad.
lines.zh: : 只是有点好笑。甚至挺可爱。因为我或者我的朋友跟我爸在一起时，你好像从来不吃醋。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime20
: Well, yeah. This is a grown woman we’re talking about this time. And you like her too. So it’s like a double whammy of jealousness.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。这次说的可是个成年女人。而且你也喜欢她。所以这是双重的嫉妒打击。

lines.en: : So her age is the main factor? You don’t think my dad could possibly fall for anyone younger?
lines.zh: : 所以她的年龄是主要因素？你觉得我爸不可能爱上更年轻的人？

lines.en: : I...try not to think about that, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 我……说实话尽量不去想那个。

lines.en: : Is that because you have faith that he wouldn’t actually do anything like that? Or because you’d have no choice but to live in a constant state of worry if you did?
lines.zh: : 那是因为你相信他不会真做出那种事？还是因为，一旦你相信了，你就只能永远活在担忧里？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime21
: You know what? Why don’t we change topics? Tomorrow will be your first time coming to a photo-shoot, right? What if afterwards, we-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我们换个话题吧？明天是你第一次来拍摄现场，对吧？要不拍完之后，我们——

lines.en: : No, no! Don’t change the topic. As a high-schooler myself, your thoughts on this are directly relevant to us getting closer.
lines.zh: : 不不！别换话题。我自己就是女高中生，你对这事的想法直接关系到我们能不能更亲近。

lines.en: : Plus, if you have any tips on how to not be jealous of other girls my age, I’d love to hear them. Because I know I struggle having faith in my dad sometimes. Do you, Aunt Niki?
lines.zh: : 再说，如果你有什么「不吃同龄女孩的醋」的诀窍，我很想听听。因为我知道，我自己有时候也很难完全信任我爸。你呢，Niki 阿姨？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime22
: ...Of course I have faith in him. He’s...the single most important person in my life.
lines.zh: : ……我当然信任他。他是……我生命里最重要的人。

lines.en: : Noriko’s up there too though, isn’t she? And she spends a ton of time with him. Are you not worried about her? Why is it just Sara?
lines.zh: : 可 Noriko 也算吧？而且她跟他待在一起的时间那么长。你不担心她吗？为什么只盯着 Sara？

lines.en: : Noriko’s more like a little sister to Akira than anything else. I’m not...jealous of that.
lines.zh: : Noriko 对 Akira 来说更像是妹妹。我并不……嫉妒那个。

lines.en: : But you know she’s in love with him, right?
lines.zh: : 可你知道她爱上他了吧？

lines.en: : I know...she thinks she’s in love with him. The same way you do. But you two are still teenagers and...you’ll grow out of that.
lines.zh: : 我知道……她自以为爱上了他。跟你一样。可你们两个都还是十几岁的孩子，而且……你们会长大，会走出来的。

lines.en: : You’ll realize in time it was more...hormones or...admiration than actual romantic feelings. And you’ll get older and...fall for somebody else.
lines.zh: : 总有一天你们会明白，那更多是……荷尔蒙，或者……崇拜，而不是真正的爱情。你们会长大，然后……爱上别人。

lines.en: : But if my dad were to return any of those blossoming feelings-
lines.zh: : 可如果我爸回应了那些萌发的感情——

lines.en: : He wouldn’t...
lines.zh: : 他不会的……

lines.en: : He knows better than that.
lines.zh: : 他不至于那样。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime23
: Does he, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Are you sure this isn’t just another one of your “flaws?” Having too much faith in someone and just tricking yourself into thinking they’re governed by the same principles as you?
lines.zh: : 你确定这不是你的又一个「缺点」？对一个人太过信任，然后自我催眠，以为对方也受跟你一样的原则约束？

lines.en: : How do you think that happens to someone, Aunt Niki?
lines.zh: : 你觉得一个人怎么会变成那样呢，Niki 阿姨？

lines.en: : If it’s true that he’s worse than you imagine...do you think he’s always been that way?
lines.zh: : 如果他真的比你想象的更糟……你觉得他一直都是那样吗？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime24
: Or do you think someone made him into that?
lines.zh: : 还是你觉得，是有人把他变成了那样？

lines.en: : Okay — I just finished chapter 215. What one are you on?
lines.zh: 好了——我刚看完第 215 话。你看到哪了？

lines.en: : The middle of...210.
lines.zh: 第 210 话……中间。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime25
: Wait, really? But you always read faster than me. I figured you’d be at the end of the latest volume by now.
lines.zh: 等等，真的吗？可你平时总比我读得快。我以为你早该看到最新一卷的结尾了。

lines.en: : I guess I’m just reading slower than normal today.
lines.zh: 大概我今天读得比平时慢吧。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime26
: Oh no. I know that tone.
lines.zh: 哦不。我认得这个语气。

lines.en: : What tone? I don’t know what you mean.
lines.zh: 什么语气？我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : That tone. The one you only use when you’re mad at me and want me to ask what’s wrong so you can scold me about something.
lines.zh: 那个语气。你只有在生我气、想让我问你怎么了、好借机数落我一顿的时候，才会用那个语气。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime27
: Oh, great. Well, since you’ve asked, I think you’ve been spending a suspicious amount of time with your teacher lately.
lines.zh: 哦，好极了。行啊，既然你问了——我觉得你最近跟你那位老师待在一起的时间多得可疑。

lines.en: : And I do not approve of this since I am tired of waiting for you to be here to continue reading manga we’re supposed to read together.
lines.zh: 而我对此很不赞成，因为我受够了等你过来，好继续看我们说好一起看的漫画。

lines.en: : Then just...read it without me and I’ll catch up when I can.
lines.zh: 那就……你自己先看吧，我赶上时就补上。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Akira — do you not understand what “together” means? Has your teacher not gotten to that word yet?
lines.zh: 不好意思，Akira——你是不懂「一起」是什么意思吗？你老师还没教到这个词吗？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime28
: I just...have a lot to catch up on. And the only hours she’s available just...happen to be the hours I also spend here.
lines.zh: 我只是……有很多要补的。而她有空的时段……恰好也是我在这儿待的时段。

lines.en: : Akira, you’re the smartest boy I know. What do you possibly have to “catch up” on?
lines.zh: Akira，你是我认识的最聪明的男生。你有什么可「补」的？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime29
: W...Why do you care anyway? I’m still here every day. It’s not like I’ve just...left you behind or something.
lines.zh: 可……你为什么在意啊？我每天都还在这儿。我又没有……把你丢下之类的。

lines.en: : Because it’s weird! My parents think so too.
lines.zh: 因为这很奇怪！我爸妈也这么觉得。

lines.en: : She picks you up like every single day, they’ve never met her, and you’re always dismissive when they tell you to invite her over for dinner. Why?
lines.zh: 她几乎每天都来接你，他们从没见过她，而且每次他们让你请她来吃晚饭，你都敷衍过去。为什么？

lines.en: : Why do they want to invite her over for dinner in the first place? That’s weird!
lines.zh: 他们为什么一开始就想着请她来吃晚饭？那才奇怪吧！

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t know. Maybe because she’s in our driveway every single day and just happens to spend more time with you than your actual mom. Is that not reasonable?
lines.zh: 哦，我怎么会知道。大概因为她每天都在我们家车道上，而且碰巧跟你待的时间比你的亲妈还长。这难道不合理吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no! She’s just my teacher. There’s no reason for you or your parents to get involved.
lines.zh: 一点都不合理！她只是我的老师。你和你父母没理由插手。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime30
: Are we not allowed to worry about you or something? Because you’re basically family, Akira. And if I started spending every waking hour with some weird adult-
lines.zh: 我们连为你操心都不行了吗？你基本上就是家人啊，Akira。要是我整天整夜跟某个奇怪的成年人待在一起——

lines.en: : She’s not weird. She’s just...eccentric. And she’s engaged to my brother, so she’s family too.
lines.zh: 她不奇怪。她只是……有点古怪。而且她已经跟我哥订婚了，所以她也是家人。

lines.en: : I have a life outside of this house, Niki. And...I’d like to keep having that life without having to worry about you being there too.
lines.zh: 我在这个家之外还有自己的生活，Niki。而且……我想继续过那种生活，不用再操心你也在场。

lines.en: : Can you at least promise me you’re not in danger then?
lines.zh: 那你至少能向我保证，你没有身处险境吗？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime31
: Danger? What? Do you think she’s going to kill me?
lines.zh: 险境？什么？你觉得她会杀了我？

lines.en: : There are ways to hurt someone without killing them, Akira. I just want to know you’re okay. That’s all.
lines.zh: 伤人的方法有很多种，不一定要杀人，Akira。我只是想知道你没事。就这样。

lines.en: : I’m fine, Niki. I just need extra tutoring. That’s all.
lines.zh: 我没事，Niki。我只是需要额外的辅导。就这样。

lines.en: : You promise?
lines.zh: 你保证？

lines.en: : Yes. I promise.
lines.zh: 嗯。我保证。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime32
: Aunt Niki? Are you overheating? Do we need to get out of the bath?
lines.zh: : Niki 阿姨？你泡晕了吗？我们要不要出浴缸？

lines.en: : What do you think about Akira, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你怎么看 Akira，Ami？

lines.en: : Hm?
: Do you think he’d ever cross the line with a girl your age? Or even...want to?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他会跟你这个年纪的女孩越界吗？甚至……想过要越界吗？

lines.en: : If Noriko was your little sister, how would you feel about having her spend so much time alone with him?
lines.zh: : 如果 Noriko 是你妹妹，你会怎么看待她跟他单独待那么久？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime33
: If I was in your shoes, I think I’d definitely be worried.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，我想我肯定会担心。

lines.en: : Not because my dad is evil, though. Because he’s sad.
lines.zh: : 但不是因为我爸是坏人。是因为他很难过。

lines.en: : And he’ll take love in any form that he can get because it’s the only way he can distract himself from the pain of losing his first true love.
lines.zh: : 而他会接受任何形式的爱，因为那是他唯一能用来分散注意力、不去想失去初恋之痛的方式。

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime34
: You’re talking about your mom, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你说的是你妈妈吧？

lines.en: : Were they...
lines.zh: : 他们两个……

lines.en: : Did she...
lines.zh: : 她是不是……

lines.en: : If she did, would you think she was evil?
lines.zh: : 如果她真的做了，你会觉得她是坏人吗？

lines.en: scene nikiamibathtime32
: Yes...
: I would.
lines.zh: : 我会的。

lines.en: : Then would my dad be evil too if he did the same?
lines.zh: : 那如果我爸做了同样的事，他也是坏人吗？

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I can’t forgive anyone who would hurt Akira that way.
lines.zh: : 我无法原谅任何会那样伤害 Akira 的人。

lines.en: : Could you forgive someone who’d hurt your sister that way?
lines.zh: : 你能原谅那样伤害你妹妹的人吗？

lines.en: : No...I don’t think I’d be able to forgive someone like that either...
lines.zh: : 不能……我想我也没法原谅那样的人……

lines.en: scene black
: Then maybe you should worry, Aunt Niki.
lines.zh: : 那也许你该担心了，Niki 阿姨。

lines.en: : And maybe there are people out there who lean further into their flaws than just throwing sad words into happy-sounding songs.
lines.zh: : 也许有些人把自己的缺点发挥得更彻底，而不只是把伤感的词塞进听起来欢快的歌里。

lines.en: : I don’t think that makes them unforgivable, though.
lines.zh: : 可我不觉得那让他们不可原谅。

lines.en: : If anything, I think it might even make them beautiful.
lines.zh: : 要说有什么，我觉得那甚至可能让他们变得很美。

lines.en: : I’m sure you understand that as someone who’s learned to appreciate imperfections.
lines.zh: : 你学会了欣赏不完美，我肯定你懂这个。

lines.en: : And even if you don’t...even if you can’t, you made a promise...didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 而就算你不懂……就算你做不到，你也立过誓的……不是吗？

lines.en: : To stay by his side forever?
lines.zh: : 要永远留在他身边？

lines.en: : I did...yeah...
lines.zh: : 我立过……是啊……

lines.en: : But he made a promise to me too. And if he lied-
lines.zh: : 可他也对我立过誓。如果他撒了谎——

lines.en: : If he lied, it was only to protect you.
lines.zh: : 如果他撒谎，那也只是为了保护你。

lines.en: : Ahh...
lines.zh: : 啊啊……

lines.en: : I wish I could be as kind as him.
lines.zh: : 我真希望自己能像他一样善良。
